environment: local repository snapshot; no deployed URL
logical_location: adult access and profile age controls
applicability_reason: The project explicitly requires an 18-plus experience, but the exact activity and legal basis for an access mechanism require Spanish counsel; minor data-processing rules do not by themselves create a universal adult-site gate.
expected: Before release, the exact age policy is legally approved, profiles cannot represent minors, and any required visitor age control is accessible, proportionate, privacy-preserving and tested.
observed: Domain validation rejects profile subjects under 18, the local repository can persist an evidence reference and audit the age-confirmation decision, and the blocked release renders only a neutral holding page in production. The stored boolean/reference is a workflow gate, not proof of identity or age. No approved visitor age policy, accessible age interstitial or age-assurance mechanism exists for the final experience.
method: Static review and local integration tests of content validation, persistent evidence/audit workflow, runtime visibility, requirements and legal-input register.
preconditions: No real profiles or public release exist in the snapshot.
limitations: The service classification and proportionality of any age-assurance method are unresolved.
No identity or age provider was selected or tested.
impact: An incorrect or inaccessible age design could expose minors, exclude lawful users unnecessarily or collect excessive identity data.
prevalence: Entry to the final public experience and every profile record.

source_refs.legal_effect: Regulates when a minor may consent to personal-data processing in Spain; it is not treated here as a standalone rule requiring an 18-plus website gate.
source_refs.applicability_reason: Any final age or identity flow that processes minor data must account for the applicable Spanish data-protection rule.

false_positive_analysis: The neutral production holding state and profile-age validation prevent a present release exposure, so this is a pre-release design gap rather than proof of current minor access.
counterevidence: The blocked production experience renders no service content or contact flow.
Local evidence decisions are versioned and audited, but the system does not treat the stored reference as verified identity or legal sufficiency.
remediation_minimum: Obtain written legal/product approval of the age policy and implement the least intrusive accessible control required for the final classified service; verify that minors cannot appear as profiles and that no excessive identity data is retained.
additional_hardening: Threat-model bypass, privacy leakage, recovery and accessibility before selecting an age-assurance provider.
suggested_owner: Client, Spanish legal counsel, privacy owner and frontend engineering
retest: Exercise keyboard, screen-reader, error, privacy and bypass scenarios on the frozen staging release.
residual_risk: NO-GO until the final activity and age policy are approved and the resulting control is implemented and tested.
